name: Misc.
source:
It’s been following you for ages

Year after year

Apartment after apartment

But now it’s time

There is no turning back

You need to sort the "Misc." box.

[From [url=https://pierrec.itch.io/misc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
它已经跟随你很多年了

年复一年

一个又一个公寓

但现在是时候了

没有回头路

你需要对“杂项”进行排序。盒子。

[来自[url=https://pierrec.itch.io/misc]itch.io[/url]]
